entities.name: Commander Eesha
entities.description: An aven commander who warns against treachery, the Cabal and ambition, and wishes to change the way of the world.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A cephalid ambassador who boasts of controlling the oceans.

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: A cephalid empress.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A Cabal dementia summoner.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A lavamancer.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A pit fighter who took a goretusk firebeast as a pet in his youth.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior adept and brother of Kamahl, both from Balthor's forge.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: A dwarf who forged Kamahl and Jeska and was defiled, now weeping for what he has lost.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid who calls the Krosan Forest alive and druids its seeds.

entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: The Nantuko Primus.

entities.name: Brawn
entities.description: A mortal incarnation of the Scroll of Beginnings who arrived and shook the plane.

entities.name: Genesis
entities.description: First through the Riftstone, making the world lifeless no more.

entities.name: Glory
entities.description: A being of the Scroll of Beginnings.

entities.name: Anger
entities.description: A being who chose a shell of boiling rock.

entities.name: Valor
entities.description: A being who spread through the land.

entities.name: Wonder
entities.description: A being gazed at by awestruck birds.

entities.name: Filth
entities.description: A being who oozed through the closing portal.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A dementia master whose admirers keep his dreams alive.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: The deity worshipped by nomads.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact that transformed the Krosan Forest and its inhabitants.

entities.name: Riftstone
entities.description: A portal through which beings of the Scroll of Beginnings passed.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest transformed by the Mirari.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A death-worshipping order that betrayed the nomads.

entities.name: Nomads
entities.description: Wandering tribes who pray to the Ancestor.

events.summary: The land drinks power from the Mirari, transforming the Krosan Forest.
events.quote: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

events.summary: Genesis comes through the Riftstone and the world is lifeless no more.
events.quote: First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more.

events.summary: Filth oozes through a closing portal.
events.quote: As the portal closed, Filth oozed through.

events.summary: Brawn arrives and the plane shudders.
events.quote: "'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."

events.summary: Kamahl once kept a goretusk firebeast as a pet.
events.quote: As a youth, Kamahl took one for a pet.

events.summary: Commander Eesha declares the aven will not be victims of treachery, the Cabal or their own ambitions again.
events.quote: We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more.

events.summary: Jeska says she and Kamahl both come from Balthor's forge.
events.quote: My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge.

relations.quote: My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge.
